motion: The camera does not move. The small grey delivery robot sits alone among the empty chairs, facing the camera, its torn cloth bunting hanging across its front wheels. Its wheels do not turn and it does not rotate. Its amber beacon pulses twice, as if calling out, then waits, then pulses once more, slower, and stays on. It rocks forward very slightly on its wheels, as if leaning to listen, and settles back. The empty chairs and the pools of light beneath them stay perfectly still. The camera does not move.
